description: A polyphonic wavefolder that scales and shifts the input before folding it, with a triangular fold and a sine fold

params.text: Chooses the fold: triangular reflects the signal back each time it passes a fold point, sinusoidal passes it through a sine function
Multiplies the input before folding, 1 to 10, so the signal crosses more fold points the further clockwise it goes
Attenuates the DEPTH input; at maximum, 10V there adds 40 to the folding depth on the unipolar setting, and 5V adds 40 on bipolar
Sets the range read at the DEPTH input: unipolar for 0-10V, bipolar for -5V to 5V
Shifts the scaled signal before folding, -2.5 to 2.5, moving it across the fold points
Attenuates the OFFSET input; at maximum, 10V there adds 20 to the folding offset on the unipolar setting, and 5V adds 20 on bipolar
Sets the range read at the OFFSET input: unipolar for 0-10V, bipolar for -5V to 5V

inputs.text: The signal to be folded, read as full scale at 5V; the number of channels here sets the number of channels at OUT
Adds to the folding depth set by Depth, through its own attenuator
Adds to the folding offset set by Offset, through its own attenuator
